children: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Limited (NSE:SUNPHARMA) reported a Q charge of ~Rs1,269cr tied to a US antitrust settlement and Organon acquisition costs while mixed sales saw India up, US down, and FDA cleared ILUMYA for psoriatic arthritis as shares jumped after results amid an Assam plant compliance review.

: Sun Pharma reported exceptional Q charge ~Rs1,269 crore: Rs923 crore US antitrust settlement and Rs346 crore acquisition costs tied to the proposed Organon deal; transaction on track for early 2027.
: SUNPHARMA Q-quarter: India formulations revenue +17.3% to ₹5,552.3 crore; US formulations -8.2% to $455M; emerging markets +7.6% to $350M; global innovative medicines +6.9% to $356M
FDA Approves ILUMYA For Psoriatic Arthritis
: FDA approved Sun Pharma's ILUMYA (tildrakizumab) for adults with active psoriatic arthritis in the U.S.; dosing to be administered by a healthcare provider. Ticker: SUNPHARMA.
SUNPHARMA Assam Plant Halt and Fixes
: SUNPHARMA halted production at its Assam plant, launched fixes and filed a compliance report now under regulator review; company says it follows one global quality standard.
: Sun Pharmaceutical (SUNPHARMA) shares rose about 4.2% intraday to Rs 1,835 on the NSE after a results announcement, reflecting a notable intraday gain for traders.
